title: Residual of r1 B2: export failure arm (refcheck_toast_export_failed) still has no firing-arm test — only the Ok arm was pinned
detail: Residual of r1 B2: the recommended fix named both arms ("plus the Error arm → refcheck_toast_export_failed"); the rework pinned Ok and the verbatim const only. The failure toast's firing path is untested; a dropped or wrong error toast ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add one test dispatching AppCompletedRefcheckExport("rc-1", Error("")) on the detail route asserting the toast equals copy.refcheck_toast_export_failed (and optionally the off-route False arm).

title: Residual of r1 N12: label-table test pins exact per-status strings for only failed/completed — the other six terminal statuses assert non-empty and not "In progress" only
detail: Residual of r1 N12 (partial): the recommended fix was full-string pins per status. As written, regressions in six arms (e.g. refcheck_timeline_terminal("unreachable") → fallback "Closed", or refcheck_export_outcome("refused")) still pass CI; even the existing "Closed" assertion is satisfied by the fallback arm.
recommended_fix: Extend the test with a status→exact-label table asserting the full string for every arm (terminal + export), keeping the spec-verbatim "Closed — no reply" pin for unreachable.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: B1 restart test now feeds 4 post-correction batches pinning co_nudge + reminder ordinals "1"/"2" (neutralizing the latch turns it red); OQ-5 toast pinned at const and Ok firing arm; 5/5 terminal writers' terminalized_at stamps integration-pinned (refused, objected, complete, exhaust, sweep_terminal, mark_failed) plus substituted_at; W1/W2/W4/W5/W6 boundary and scan tests bite.
